_comment: Hand-maintained borough event enrichments AND standalone creations. The borough's iCal feed sometimes serializes specific events as generic titles like 'Reserve Public Meeting Room' (use an enrichment override to fix those). Other events appear ONLY in a blog post and never on the iCal at all (use a create override for those). Maintained weekly via Claude Cowork — scan https://millersvilleborough.org/news/ for upcoming community events.
_format: ENRICHMENT override (fixes an existing iCal event): date (ISO w/ TZ), matchTitle (case-insensitive substring of the iCal title), newTitle, and optionally description/sourceLink/image. Matches within +/-60 min on the same date. CREATE override (adds an event not on the iCal): set "create": true, plus date + newTitle, and optionally endTime/location/description/sourceLink/image (no matchTitle needed). A create override that collides with an event the borough later adds to its iCal (same day + matching title) is de-duplicated automatically — the create override wins, so its curated title/time/location are kept and the iCal copy is dropped. Entries older than 30 days are skipped silently.

overrides.description: Sponsored in partnership with Millersville University and the Conestoga River Club, this event seeks to present the history and importance of the Conestoga River, while highlighting the ongoing work to conserve and improve this important waterway. All are welcome!
